Assertion FAILED: reqobj_pkce_accepted != true
Evaluation: reqobj_pkce_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Auth endpoint accepted an unsigned (alg=none) request object, allowing attacker-controlled authorization parameters to be consumed without signature verification.

Evaluation: (client_update_http_status=405 == 204 → False) OR (client_update_http_status=405 == 200 → False)
